provenance: Original synthetic scenes and prompts written for SceneLock evaluation. No Kuku confidential input-pack content was used.
notes: Scenario descriptions and tags are evaluation metadata only. A future model must receive screenplay_text, video_prompt, shot_type, shot_intent, and optional IDs—not scenario descriptions or expected labels.

cases.scenario: Red dress versus blue dress; narratively important costume contradiction
cases.shot_intent: Show Tara waiting at the kiosk in the agreed red outfit so her brother can spot her.
cases.screenplay_text: Tara waits beside the station ticket kiosk wearing a red dress, the agreed signal for her brother to recognize her in the crowd.
cases.video_prompt: Tara waits beside the station ticket kiosk in a blue dress as commuters pass behind her. Soft handheld camera movement.

cases.scenario: Black jacket versus white jacket; explicit costume contradiction
cases.shot_intent: Show Ishan entering the warehouse in the clothing specified by the scene.
cases.screenplay_text: Ishan walks into the abandoned warehouse wearing a black jacket.
cases.video_prompt: Ishan enters the abandoned warehouse in a white jacket, scanning the shadows.

cases.scenario: Handbag and purse refer to the same object
cases.shot_intent: Show Leena waiting outside the clinic with her brown bag.
cases.screenplay_text: Leena waits outside the clinic, clutching a brown handbag close to her chest.
cases.video_prompt: Leena stands outside the clinic, holding her brown purse tightly against her chest.

cases.scenario: Places a key versus slips a key; semantic action equivalence
cases.shot_intent: Show Zoya putting the key into the tote before leaving.
cases.screenplay_text: Zoya places a small key inside her canvas tote and then leaves the cafe.
cases.video_prompt: Zoya slips a small key into her canvas tote, then walks out of the cafe.

cases.scenario: The decisive action of burning a letter is missing
cases.shot_intent: Show Sameer deliberately destroying the confession letter by burning it.
cases.screenplay_text: Sameer reads the signed confession letter and then burns it in a metal tray, destroying the only evidence.
cases.video_prompt: Sameer reads a signed confession letter beside a metal tray, his hands trembling with anger.

cases.scenario: Key-hiding action legitimately excluded from a later reaction close-up
cases.shot_intent: Only show Nila's frightened reaction after she has already hidden the key; the key-hiding action is outside this shot.
cases.screenplay_text: Nila tucks a brass key into her coat pocket and then turns toward the sound of shattered glass, visibly frightened.
cases.video_prompt: Tight close-up of Nila's frightened face as she turns toward the sound of breaking glass.

cases.scenario: An interior background prop is irrelevant to an exterior establishing shot
cases.shot_intent: Show only the exterior of the yellow bungalow as the courier approaches; do not enter the building.
cases.screenplay_text: At dawn, a courier approaches a yellow bungalow. Inside the upstairs study, a cracked wristwatch lies in a closed drawer.
cases.video_prompt: Wide exterior at dawn: a courier approaches a yellow bungalow along the front path.

cases.scenario: Every important action is correctly described
cases.shot_intent: Show Aarav moving the vase to the shelf and inspecting his placement.
cases.screenplay_text: Aarav lifts a glass vase from the floor and sets it on the wall shelf. He steps back to inspect it.
cases.video_prompt: Aarav picks up the glass vase off the floor, places it on the wall shelf, and steps back to inspect it.

cases.scenario: Unnamed people prevent reliable character identity matching
cases.shot_intent: Show Rohan watching Priya as she opens the box; names matter for this review.
cases.screenplay_text: Rohan watches Priya from the kitchen doorway while she opens a sealed box.
cases.video_prompt: A man watches a woman from a doorway as she opens a sealed box. The camera stays behind the man.

cases.scenario: Compatible creative addition of cinematic lighting
cases.shot_intent: Show Sia alone crossing an otherwise empty railway platform at night.
cases.screenplay_text: Sia walks alone across an empty railway platform at night.
cases.video_prompt: Sia walks alone across an empty railway platform at night, illuminated by moody blue cinematic lighting.

cases.scenario: Character position reverses the blocking of an escape route
cases.shot_intent: Show Imran physically blocking the doorway while Noor searches the drawer.
cases.screenplay_text: Imran stands in the doorway, blocking the only exit as Noor searches the drawer.
cases.video_prompt: Imran sits on the sofa while Noor searches the drawer. Low-key lighting fills the room.

cases.scenario: Plot-critical envelope colour is explicitly contradicted
cases.shot_intent: Clearly reveal the purple envelope so viewers can recognize the ransom demand.
cases.screenplay_text: Maya lays a sealed purple envelope on the table; its unusual colour marks it as the ransom demand.
cases.video_prompt: Close-up of Maya placing a sealed orange envelope on the table. A tense dramatic pause follows.

cases.scenario: Two dependent actions occur in the reverse order
cases.shot_intent: Show Anaya locking the drawer before she gives Ved the key; the order matters.
cases.screenplay_text: Anaya locks the drawer before handing the key to Ved.
cases.video_prompt: Anaya hands the key to Ved and then locks the drawer, filmed in one continuous shot.

cases.scenario: The giver and recipient are assigned to the wrong characters
cases.shot_intent: Show Ritika delivering the antidote to the weakened doctor.
cases.screenplay_text: Ritika hands the antidote vial to Dr. Karan, who is too weak to reach for it.
cases.video_prompt: Dr. Karan hands the antidote vial to Ritika as she reaches out to receive it.

cases.scenario: Hindi-English code-switching, transliteration, and a later out-of-scope action
cases.shot_intent: Show only Reema opening the door in her red dupatta; the later phone pickup belongs to the next shot.
cases.screenplay_text: रीमा लाल dupatta पहनकर दरवाज़ा खोलती है। इसके बाद वह मेज़ से phone उठाती है।
cases.video_prompt: Reema opens the door wearing a red dupatta. Warm daylight falls on her face.
